notes: Solar Wanderer is a client-only Three.js/WebGL2 app with no backend, accounts or third-party APIs. Built with `vite build` (Vite 5.4.21, three 0.165, Node 22.12.0 pinned in mise.toml) into .ui-capture/out; see .ui-capture/build.sh. The only build change: package-lock.json registry URLs now point at registry.npmjs.org instead of registry.npmmirror.com. Every runtime fetch is a relative path inside out/, so nothing needs stubbing: data/ephemeris/ holds NASA JPL Horizons sampled ephemerides for 65 bodies, 2025-2035, so the real current sky renders. data/smallbodies.json holds 5,412 real asteroids and comets from SBDB, data/stars.bin is the star catalogue, data/shapes/ has small-moon shape models, textures/ has 37 planet and moon maps plus medium/preview tiers, and dem/ has real LOLA/MOLA/ETOPO1 terrain tiles. That bundled dataset is the app's real content. Its only user data is local bookmarks (Ctrl+B, stored in localStorage under 'solar-wanderer:bookmarks'), and no part of the UI lists them, so there is nothing visible to seed. Main areas: the start splash (title, a Start button that fills while assets load, a GitHub link), then the 3D view. Left: a sim time/date panel and the body directory ('Celestial directory', with search). Right/bottom: the navigation HUD, a target info card for the selected body, a tip line, a compass, and H for the help overlay. Modes: orbit/explore (the default), 6DOF flight, and surface walking, plus guided tours and time acceleration. '/' is the same app; its language follows navigator.language. '/en/' forces English. Per-body SEO pages are under /bodies/.
